about: Check-in chat replies for check-chat-context.mjs (made-up students). Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

why matched.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched.reply: The app matched you because you both enjoy live music and gigs, and like similar weekends at the cinema. You also both asked for a laid-back mentor.

how often.reply:
You asked to meet every two weeks. 
You can find your mentor's details on the [[Your Mentor]] page.

checklist.reply: You have two tasks left on your checklist: [[Book]] and finding a dentist.

who is my mentor.reply: Your mentor's name and how to get in touch are on the [[Your Mentor]] page.

course society.ask: Can you suggest a society for my course?
course society.reply: Since you study English Literature, [[English]] is a great one to try.

why matched, waiting.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched, waiting.reply: The mentoring coordinator is finding you a mentor by hand, and once they're matched, your mentor's name and how to get in touch will be on the [[Your Mentor]] page. You asked to meet weekly, and you can see more details or ask for a different mentor there too.

why matched, no mentor.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched, no mentor.reply: You haven't been matched with a mentor yet, but you can ask for one on the [[Find a mentor]] page.

change mentor.ask: I don’t think my mentor is right for me. Can I change?
change mentor.reply: You can ask the mentoring coordinator for a different one on the [[Your Mentor]] page. Your reason goes only to the coordinator and your mentor never sees it.
